description: Inline snapshots formatted with the project's Prettier 3 (B23d B1, T7.11): `.prettierrc` has `semi: false`, so after the write the whole file is Prettier's (double quotes, no semicolons) and each multi-line snapshot is indented to its call, an `await` parent's column for `.resolves`. Jest 30.5.2 with its default `prettierPath`, which finds the Prettier 3.9.8 the recorder's work directory can resolve.
